BiblicalUsage: Ezekiel hears the word of the Lord: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it, until he come whose right it is. One word of overthrow, repeated three times, against a corrupt crown.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God overturns what men build crooked, and he does it until the rightful King comes.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
